theorems.name: Submission.stationary_density_usc_of_ratio_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ) (U : Set (Ambient n ℓ)), IsOpen U → IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts V.weight → (∀ ξ ∈ U, V.HasDensityAt ξ (V.density ξ)) → (∀ (η : Ambient n ℓ) (R ρ : ℝ), closedBall η R ⊆ U → 0 < ρ → ρ < R → V.density η ≤ V.weight.real (closedBall η ρ) / (omega n * ρ ^ n)) → UpperSemicontinuousOn V.density U
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
